newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo Truck agenda aims to lift earnings.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Truck agenda aims to lift earnings.

text.p: Volvo Truck must earn at least 3.5 billion crowns a year to give value to shareholders, managing director Erling Trogen told newspaper Volvo Globetrotter.

"Our earning capability must be at least 3.5 billion crowns a year. With that level we can invest in new products and in new markets and give our shareholders a resonable return for their risk capital," Trogen told the newspaper.
Agenda 96 is a programme designed to give Volvo Truck good profitability. The programme will be followed up constantly and will be introduced in full by at the latest 1998.
By then the company aimed to have lifted its performance to guarantee earning capability of 3.5 billion as opposed to three billion crowns.
"Agenda 96 builds up quality, costs and capital. But let me just add another one - customer," he said.
